name: Pöschl Tabak
desc: Family-owned Bavarian tobacco maker, describing itself as the world's largest snuff producer, exporting to over 100 countries.
products: Snuff (Gletscherprise, Ozona, Gawith), fine-cut and pipe tobacco (Pueblo, Brookfield, Radford's), Pueblo cigarettes
stores_or_sites: Production and administration in Geisenhausen; 15 subsidiary and affiliated companies
markets: Germany and exports to over 100 countries
fit_rationale: Large family tobacco exporter in 100+ countries; any F1 use would be corporate hospitality for distributors in markets where tobacco sponsorship is legal, not consumer branding.
f1_markets: Germany-adjacent European races, plus export markets

access.roles: Geschäftsführung (Katharina Pöschl, Patrick Engels named as managing directors)

compliance: Tobacco company. EU Tobacco Advertising Directive 2003/33/EC bans tobacco sponsorship of events with cross-border effect and most tobacco advertising; WHO FCTC Art. 13 requires comprehensive advertising, promotion and sponsorship bans in ratifying states; national laws (e.g. German Tabakerzeugnisgesetz) add further limits. Any F1 deal would need legal review and could only cover non-tobacco branding, corporate hospitality or markets where permitted.
outstanding: Wikipedia text gives 2020 revenue of over EUR 639m and ~930 staff worldwide, conflicting with infobox (596, 2023); confirm in Bundesanzeiger. Legal feasibility of any sponsorship.
